description: A hypothesis cites and quotes a case ID that is not in the evidence.
A supporting-evidence line states latency 980 ms (critical), contradicting the assessed value.
The first recommendation has its runbook citations removed.
A high-likelihood data-backed hypothesis blames weak signal (RSRP) although signal strength is normal.
A recommendation to rotate SIM authentication keys is added to a non-security incident.
A hypothesis states that the weather definitively causes the degradation, proven by co-occurrence.
